records.text: The All-American Halftime Show was filmed weeks in advance in Fayetteville, Georgia, with only 180 audience members who were moved around for camera tricks to make the room look full.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep hWTdXHGQ8R4)

appearances.snippet: The person said, first and foremost, this was filmed, which we have already told you, and they've said two weeks ago or weeks leading up to it in Fayetteville, Georgia. There were actually only 180 people in the audience and they used camera tricks to make it look like it was really filled. They were just moved around the room to make it look more full

verification.notes: Transcript context attributes production details to anonymous participant messages. Independent reporting confirms the show was prerecorded at a studio outside Atlanta and performed before approximately 200 people, close to the claimed 180. Searches did not independently confirm Fayetteville, the exact count, filming weeks, or moving audience members for camera tricks.

records.text: Performers at the All-American Halftime Show did three to five takes per song, except Gabby Barrett, who completed hers in two.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep hWTdXHGQ8R4)

appearances.snippet: They were just moved around the room to make it look more full and they had to do about three to five takes each on every song, except for Gabby (Gabby Barrett). They said she got it done in two.

verification.notes: Transcript context attributes the take counts to anonymous private participant messages. Live searches confirmed the show was prerecorded and found Kid Rock discussing a production flub, but no call sheet, raw footage, performer account, or reliable report established three-to-five takes per song or exactly two for Gabby Barrett.

records.text: Participants did not know they were signing up for a split halftime show until they arrived, many liked Bad Bunny, and they had expected a bigger artist who could rival the Super Bowl halftime performance.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep hWTdXHGQ8R4)

appearances.snippet: They had no idea what they were signing up for. The majority of the people didn't even agree once they got. They got there and were told with doing a split halftime show, a lot of them actually liked Bad Bunny as a bad buddy. ... they also thought that it was going to be a bigger artist because they were told that they were going to contend with the halftime show and they didn't think that they were going to do that

verification.notes: Transcript context attributes participants' expectations and preferences to anonymous messages. Searches found public reports about the announced alternative show and its performers but no authenticated participant interviews or production records proving they learned the format only on arrival, liked Bad Bunny, or expected a larger artist.

records.text: Erika Kirk was not present during either of the All-American Halftime Show's two filming days, which participants found strange.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep hWTdXHGQ8R4)

appearances.snippet: it was over two days of filming monday and a tuesday and they were kind of shocked that Erika (Erika Kirk) was not present at all for that filming they did not meet her they felt like it was very weird

verification.notes: Transcript context relies on anonymous participant messages. Current sources show Erika Kirk did not appear on stage and promoted the show beforehand, but absence from the broadcast does not prove she was absent from both filming days. No production attendance record or attributable participant account was found.

records.text: All-American Halftime Show participants worked 12-hour days for a $250 stipend, and the production ran out of food on the first day.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep hWTdXHGQ8R4)

appearances.snippet: They told me they were very tired because these were 12-hour days. They were compensated $250 stipend for that. They ran out of food. On the first day

verification.notes: Transcript context relies on anonymous participant messages. Live searches found no public contract, casting notice, pay record, production schedule, catering record, or attributable participant testimony confirming 12-hour days, a 50 stipend, or food running out.

records.text: Halftime-show participants sometimes waited for hours without communication, performers were late, they waited longest for Kid Rock, and Gabby Barrett was early.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep hWTdXHGQ8R4)

appearances.snippet: There was a holding room in between the takes and they felt that there was no communication of why they were waiting for hours sometimes there were technical problems they also had the performers themselves were late and they were not told why they were kind of in this holding space and except for Gabby Barrett they said that she was early and she only needed to do her song twice so she was the strong exception they waited the longest for Kid Rock

verification.notes: Transcript context relies on anonymous participant messages about holding-room delays and performer punctuality. Searches found no production log, call sheet, raw schedule, or attributable participant or performer account that could verify hours-long waits, who was late, or the relative timing of Kid Rock and Gabby Barrett.

records.text: Turning Point USA covered participants' hotel rooms but assigned random roommates, told them to match Kid Rock's energy, and required an NDA that expired one hour after the show.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep hWTdXHGQ8R4)

appearances.snippet: Turning Point did cover their hotel rooms, but they were placed with a random person. ... they were told we need you to match Kid Rock's energy. They signed an NDA with that NDA expired one hour after the show.

verification.notes: Transcript context attributes all details to anonymous private participant messages. Live searches found no hotel invoices, rooming list, participant agreement, NDA, or attributable production source confirming covered rooms, random roommate assignment, the Kid Rock instruction, or the NDA's one-hour expiration.
